title: Topic contract (frontmatter of topic.md)
description: A topic is a research theme, not a device. Its boundary is drawn by shared physics and shared synthesis theory: two devices belong to the same topic when knowledge about one transfers to the other. Naming similarity is not evidence of that, which is why a 'phase shifter' family can legitimately split across two topics. The prose body of topic.md carries the shared physical background; only the fields below are machine-read.

shared_physics.description: What actually transfers between designs in this topic: the synthesis theory, the governing mechanism, the design equations. This is the topic boundary made explicit and is the field to argue with when deciding whether a new design belongs here.

local_path.description: Path inside brain/raw/ when the source has been ingested.
